import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Format a blog post for safe display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- post_title : str The headline or title of the blog post. post_body : str The full text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and HTML‑formatted string ready to be injected into a page. """ # Escape all user supplied content to prevent XSS attacks (CWE‑79). safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
